name: com.parkyn.bounded-buoyancy
description: Stable, accurate buoyancy for Rigidbody and Rigidbody2D. The added mass of the water a body displaces goes into its inertia every physics step, so buoyancy drives no fall faster than g and no rise faster than g/C, for every density. Any collider shape tilts and rights itself; water volumes with waves and currents; air, balloons and thin air; wind with gusts and sails; splashes with events; and a 2D version. Method and benchmarks: Parkyn, N. (2026), Bounded Buoyancy: Added Mass and Two Ceilings for Stable, Accurate Buoyancy in Game and Simulation Engines.

samples.description: Eight 3D scenes (release, float, tilt, waves, sky, many, river, wind) and a 2D scene, built in code. After importing, use Tools > Bounded Buoyancy > Play 3D Demo (or Play 2D Demo).
